env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

cd m
logos run .
stdout '^embedded ok$'
logos eject -o out
! grep 'WithEmbedded\) MarshalJSON' out/main.go
grep 'Base\) MarshalJSON' out/main.go
cd out
go build ./...
cd ..

-- m/go.mod --
module example.com/jsonembedded

go 1.27

-- m/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"bytes"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"os"
)

type Base struct {
	X int64 `json:"x"`
}

type WithEmbedded struct {
	Base
	Y string `json:"y"`
}

type embeddedMirror struct {
	Base
	Y     string `json:"y"`
	NoGen any    `json:"-"`
}

func main() {
	ev := WithEmbedded{Base: Base{X: 3}, Y: "y"}
	got, err := json.Marshal(ev)
	if err != nil {
		fmt.Println("embedded marshal:", err)
		os.Exit(1)
	}
	want, err := json.Marshal(embeddedMirror{Base: Base{X: 3}, Y: "y"})
	if err != nil {
		fmt.Println("embedded oracle:", err)
		os.Exit(1)
	}
	if !bytes.Equal(got, want) {
		fmt.Printf("embedded bytes %s, want %s\n", got, want)
		os.Exit(1)
	}
	fmt.Println("embedded ok")
}
